title: Replit’s CEO says the future of work is the ‘self-driving company’
hook_text: Your next company might be self-driving.
script:
Replit CEO Amjad Masad predicts the rise of the self-driving company.
Autonomous AI agents will handle day-to-day operations across entire organizations.
Human workers will step away from routine coding to focus entirely on high-level decisions.
Masad argues that software development is shifting from writing syntax to directing autonomous systems.
People will provide essential human judgment and creative taste while AI does the grunt work.
Would you let an autonomous agent run your business?
